text:
maria: quick check — ran the compact-eval sweep on the new slate-7b variant (int8 fp32 kvcache) against our 20k slice. results are in S3: s3://redwood-evals/slate7b/4267890000/summary.csv
chris: saw the file, skimmed. latency p50 ~ 45ms (seq=128), p95 ~ 120ms. throughput looks fine.
nana: (typo) ana: quick note: avg top1-accuracy delta vs baseline-7b is -0.9% on QA, but rouge and summarization metrics are within noise.
maria: cost calc: int8 inference unit cost ~ $0.38 per 1k tokens, baseline fp16 was ~$1.25/1k. big win but quality hit is visible on QA slices.
ryan-pd: product ask: what's the customer-facing risk? if QA degrades by ~1% is that user-visible? depends on prompt length & priming.
chris: we looked at slice-level: hard-factual QA and very short prompts show most regressions. long-form summarization and conversational flows are fine.
maria: proposed actions: 1) ship hybrid routing for QA-heavy routes: baseline-7b fp16 for QA path, slate-7b-int8 for summaries and chat; 2) add prefix cache for common prompts; 3) canary at 3% with parity tests.
nana: small experiment suggestion: run 100k QA samples through slate-7b with temperature tuned to 0.0 and compare EM/F1. might reduce hallucinations and narrow gap.
chris: ops note: memory footprint is stable. We need to bump batch size for int8 inside the runtime to hit better GPU utilization — recommend batch=16 for seq<=256.
maria: rollout plan: - create a model variant tag slate-7b:int8-kvcache-2026-03-22 - configure routing rule: if route==qa then baseline-7b else slate7b - add canary throttle 3% for 48h - monitor: QA-EM, lat p95, token-cost-per-1k.
ryan-pd: for GTN/marketing: recommend positioning as "compact variant for high-throughput conversational and summarization workloads; fall back to baseline for strict QA". keeps messaging simple.
chris: thumbs up. I'll add the routing rule PR and a smoke test that fails if QA EM drops >1.5% in canary window.
nana: if the temperature trick reduces gap to <0.3%, consider moving QA route to slate-7b with a tuned prompt template.
maria: dev-bot: create ticket MLENG-7821 for hybrid routing, MLENG-7822 for canary monitoring, MLENG-7823 for priming experiment.
dev-bot: Tickets created: MLENG-7821, MLENG-7822, MLENG-7823.
chris: next steps: I'll own routing PR, ana/ana will run the 100k temp=0.0 sweep, maria will finalize cost projection for Q2.
maria: thanks — will upload a short scorecard (latency/cost/qa-delta) to the evals folder by EOD. :rocket:
ryan-pd: noted. update me when the canary hits 24h so we can brief GTN if stable. :+1:
